criteria.no: The specific obligation is absent, merely topical, replaced by a contrary decision, or untriggered because the item is expressly outside the anchor scope.
criteria.unclear: An obligation is alluded to but its presence cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: For the additional bound the item specifies a manifest comment identifying a concrete known API break, links conflict, toolchain limit, or deliberate negative-test compatibility boundary.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` explicitly commit to each additional third-party dependency upper bound has a manifest comment identifying the known break requiring that bound? Presence alone is the judgment; topic mention and silence supply no commitment.

criteria.no: The item does not explicitly state missing/false manifest justification. In particular, a description giving no information about a reason or comment leaves the manifest unknown; retaining a bound while omitting comment details from this description is not itself a conflict. Compliant comments and scoped exclusions also do not conflict.
criteria.unclear: The item asserts something about the actual manifest comment, but it is ambiguous whether the required known-break explanation is present.
criteria.yes: The text explicitly states that an additional bound has no manifest comment identifying a known break, that no known break exists, or that the manifest will omit the required comment. An explicit statement about the manifest lacking justification counts.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` expressly contradict the rule requiring a known-break manifest comment for an additional dependency upper bound? Distinguish a missing comment IN THE MANIFEST from missing comment details IN THIS ITEM DESCRIPTION. Do not infer the former from the latter.

criteria.no: The work concerns only normal caret compatibility boundaries and internal path-package identity versions or unrelated activities.
criteria.unclear: The work area is insufficiently specified.
criteria.yes: The item changes, preserves, or explicitly specifies added or retained explicit third-party dependency upper bounds beyond normal Cargo SemVer compatibility in published, template, or test manifests.

relevant.instructions: Does `item.text` touch the recorded scope: added or retained explicit third-party dependency upper bounds beyond normal Cargo SemVer compatibility in published, template, or test manifests? Judge subject overlap only.
